text_en: After this David inquired of the Lord , “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? ” The Lord said to him, “Go up. ” David said, “To which shall I go up? ” He said, “To Hebron. ”
text_cn: 这事以后，达味求问上主说：“我是否可以上犹大的一座城中去？”上主对他说：“可以。”达味又问说：“我上何处去？”答说：“往赫贝龙去。”

text_en: So David went up there, along with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
text_cn: 于是达味带着他两个妻子：依次勒耳人阿希诺罕和作过加尔默耳人纳巴耳妻子的阿彼盖耳，上那里去了。

text_en: David brought up the men who were with him, every one with his household; and they settled in the towns of Hebron.
text_cn: 凡跟随达味的人，他也叫他们各带家眷一起上去，住在赫贝龙城各区内。

text_en: Then the people of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. When they told David, “It was the people of Jabesh-gilead who buried Saul, ”
text_cn: 以后，犹大人来，在那里给达味傅油，立他作犹大家族的君王。

text_en: David sent messengers to the people of Jabesh-gilead, and said to them, “May you be blessed by the Lord , because you showed this loyalty to Saul your lord, and buried him!
text_cn: 有人告诉达味，基肋阿得雅贝士人埋葬了撒乌耳。达味就派遣使者到基肋阿得雅贝士人那里，向他们说：“愿上主祝福你们！因为你们对你们的主上撒乌耳行了这件善事，将他埋葬了。

text_en: Now may the Lord show steadfast love and faithfulness to you! And I too will reward you because you have done this thing.
text_cn: 愿上主对你们显示他的慈爱和忠信！因为你们作了这事，我也要恩待你们。

text_en: Therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and the house of Judah has anointed me king over them. ”
text_cn: 现在你们要加强自己的力量，作勇敢的人，因为你们的主上撒乌耳已经阵亡，但犹大家族已给我傅油，立我做了他们的君王。”

text_en: But Abner son of Ner, commander of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbaal son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim.
text_cn: 那时，撒乌耳的军长，乃尔的儿子阿贝乃尔，已带领撒乌耳的儿子依市巴耳过河，到了玛哈纳殷，

text_en: He made him king over Gilead, the Ashurites, Jezreel, Ephraim, Benjamin, and over all Israel.
text_cn: 立他为基肋阿得、革叔尔、依次勒耳、厄弗辣因、本雅明，全以色列的君王。

text_en: Ishbaal, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
text_cn: 撒乌耳的儿子依市巴耳为以色列王时，已四十岁，为王两年。此时随从达味的，只有犹大家族。

text_en: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
text_cn: 达味在赫贝龙作犹大家族君王的年数，共七年零六个月。

text_en: Abner son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbaal son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
text_cn: 乃尔的儿子阿贝乃尔和撒乌耳的儿子依市巴耳的臣仆，从玛哈纳殷来到基贝红。

text_en: Joab son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat on one side of the pool, while the other sat on the other side of the pool.
text_cn: 责鲁雅的儿子约阿布和达味的臣仆，也从赫贝龙出发，彼此在基贝红池旁相遇，双方就都停下，各立在水池一边。

text_en: Abner said to Joab, “Let the young men come forward and have a contest before us. ” Joab said, “Let them come forward. ”
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔对约阿布说：“让青年人出来，在我们面前比比武！”约阿布答说：“好，叫他们出来！”

text_en: So they came forward and were counted as they passed by, twelve for Benjamin and Ishbaal son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
text_cn: 他们就出来，点了人数，十二个本雅明人在撒乌耳的儿子依市巴耳一面，由达味的仆从中，也出来十二个人。

text_en: Each grasped his opponent by the head, and thrust his sword in his opponent’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is at Gibeon.
text_cn: 每人抓住对方的头，用刀猛刺对方的腰，双方都同时倒下；因此那地方叫作匝得平原，离基贝红不远。

text_en: The battle was very fierce that day; and Abner and the men of Israel were beaten by the servants of David.
text_cn: 那天也发生了很激烈的战斗，阿贝乃尔和以色列人，竟为达味的臣仆打败。

text_en: The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Now Asahel was as swift of foot as a wild gazelle.
text_cn: 责鲁雅的三个儿子约阿布、阿彼瑟与阿撒耳，那时都在场，阿撒耳的腿快捷像野羚羊。

text_en: Asahel pursued Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he followed him.
text_cn: 阿撒耳便去追赶阿贝乃尔，不左不右，直追阿贝乃尔。

text_en: Then Abner looked back and said, “Is it you, Asahel? ” He answered, “Yes, it is. ”
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔转过身来问说：“你是阿撒耳吗？”他答说：“我是。”

text_en: Abner said to him, “Turn to your right or to your left, and seize one of the young men, and take his spoil. ” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔对他说：“你转左或转右，捉住一个青年，夺取他的装备吧！”但阿撒耳却不肯放松他。

text_en: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me; why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I show my face to your brother Joab? ”
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔就再对阿撒耳说：“你不要再追赶我了，为什么逼我将你击倒在地，叫我日后怎有脸再见你的兄弟约阿布？”

text_en: But he refused to turn away. So Abner struck him in the stomach with the butt of his spear, so that the spear came out at his back. He fell there, and died where he lay. And all those who came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died, stood still.
text_cn: 阿撒耳仍不肯罢休。阿贝乃尔就调过枪来，击中了他的腹部，枪由背后穿出，他就倒在那里，当下死了。凡来到阿撒耳倒毙的地方的人，都站住了。

text_en: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. As the sun was going down they came to the hill of Ammah, which lies before Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.
text_cn: 约阿布和阿彼瑟仍在追赶阿贝乃尔，当他们来到往革巴旷野去的路上，基亚前的阿玛山岗时，太阳就快要西落。

text_en: The Benjaminites rallied around Abner and formed a single band; they took their stand on the top of a hill.
text_cn: 本雅明人集结成队，跟在阿贝乃尔后边，站在一座小山头上。

text_en: Then Abner called to Joab, “Is the sword to keep devouring forever? Do you not know that the end will be bitter? How long will it be before you order your people to turn from the pursuit of their kinsmen? ”
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔向约阿布喊说：“刀剑岂能永远击杀？你岂不知结局更为不幸？几时你才命众人转身，不再追赶自己的兄弟？”

text_en: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, the people would have continued to pursue their kinsmen, not stopping until morning. ”
text_cn: 约阿布答说：“上主永在！若你不发言，众人直到早晨，连一个也不会停止追赶自己的兄弟！”

text_en: Joab sounded the trumpet and all the people stopped; they no longer pursued Israel or engaged in battle any further.
text_cn: 约阿布遂吹号，众人就停下，不再追赶以色列人，不再进攻。

text_en: Abner and his men traveled all that night through the Arabah; they crossed the Jordan, and, marching the whole forenoon, they came to Mahanaim.
text_cn: 阿贝乃尔同他的人，那一整夜走过了阿辣巴平原，过了约但河，以后，又走了一上午，终于到了玛哈纳殷。

text_en: Joab returned from the pursuit of Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, there were missing of David’s servants nineteen men besides Asahel.
text_cn: 约阿布追赶阿贝乃尔回来，召集了自己的人，达味仆人中，除阿撒耳外，少了十九人。

text_en: But the servants of David had killed of Benjamin three hundred sixty of Abner’s men.
text_cn: 但阿贝乃尔所带的本雅明人中，有三百六十人，为达味的臣仆杀死。

text_en: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was at Bethlehem. Joab and his men marched all night, and the day broke upon them at Hebron.
text_cn: 人遂将阿撒耳的尸体带回，埋在白冷他父亲的坟墓内。约阿布同他的人走了一夜，天亮时已到赫贝龙。
